surface: The Octane-native surface contains Badge, Banner, Breadcrumbs, Button, RefreshButton, LinkButton, Loader and SkeletonLine, Tooltip, TooltipProvider, LinkProvider, KumoPortalProvider, Label, Field, Input, InputArea and its Textarea alias, InputGroup, SensitiveInput, Select, Autocomplete, Combobox, Meter, Empty, Text, Link, LayerCard and its deprecated Surface wrapper, Grid and GridItem, CloudflareLogo and PoweredByCloudflare, TableOfContents with its active-id hook, Tabs, Toolbar, the deprecated MenuBar with its navigation hook, the complete Collapsible, Dialog, Popover, DropdownMenu, Checkbox, Sidebar, and Switch families, and the generic Radio family with its direct RadioGroup export. Presence records availability only; the remaining Kumo catalog and primitive subpaths are not yet exported.
divergences: Handlers receive native DOM events rather than React synthetic events.
Refs use Octane ref-as-prop rather than React forwardRef.
Icon components and descriptors use @octanejs/phosphor-icons and Octane types.

Collapsible panels are kept mounted only during SSR hydration to avoid Octane's detached insertion-anchor failure when an initially closed Base UI disclosure first opens; normal post-hydration mounting behavior is preserved.

Dialog, Popover, and DropdownMenu portal shells are kept mounted only during SSR hydration to avoid Octane's detached insertion-anchor failure when an initially closed Base UI overlay first opens; popup content preserves normal post-hydration unmounting behavior.

Tabs implements native WAI-ARIA tab behavior at the Kumo boundary because @octanejs/base-ui 0.1.48 omits tab children from server output; the public Kumo controlled, uncontrolled, activation, rendering, overflow, and styling contracts are preserved.
Toolbar implements its native WAI-ARIA composite behavior at the Kumo boundary because @octanejs/base-ui 0.1.48 has no toolbar module.

Select, Autocomplete, and Combobox adapt Kumo's arbitrary values to @octanejs/aria collection keys. Kumo's side, align, offset, portal, and ordinary collision-flipping controls are mapped; Base UI-only anchor tracking, sticky positioning, alignItemWithTrigger, and advanced collision configuration remain accepted compatibility props without native behavior.

Select, Autocomplete, and Combobox keep an empty ARIA popover shell mounted only during SSR hydration to avoid Octane's detached insertion-anchor failure when an initially closed collection popup first opens; popup content preserves normal post-hydration mounting behavior.

Custom Autocomplete and Combobox filters receive values resolved from option text; distinct options with identical text cannot be distinguished by this ARIA filter adapter. Combobox.useFilter accepts multiple/value options but does not reproduce Base UI's selected-query browse exception. Positioning offsets currently accept numbers only and sides are physical rather than logical inline-start/inline-end.

Sidebar Content uses a plain overflow viewport because @octanejs/base-ui 0.1.48 has no scroll-area module; custom thumb and mask-fade are dropped while data-sidebar viewport attributes for scrollToItem are preserved.
The emergency octane-kumo/react compatibility subpath is not present because this slice has no irreducibly React-backed surface.
ssr: Button, Tooltip, Badge, Meter, SkeletonLine, Empty, Collapsible, Dialog, Popover, DropdownMenu, Input, InputArea, InputGroup, SensitiveInput, standalone and grouped Checkbox, Switch, and Radio, Select, Autocomplete, Combobox, Tabs, Toolbar, and MenuBar are covered for real server compilation, hydration node adoption, and post-hydration interaction. Broader component SSR and hydration remain unverified.
notes: Button-family DOM behavior, native events, refs, loading transitions, icon forms, and tooltip trigger composition have repo-authored Octane tests.
Tooltip focus/Escape interaction, portal routing, hydration, and a browser-rendered open state have repo-authored Octane evidence.

Label, Field, and Input associations, native input events and refs, Base UI-style value details, validation precedence, password-manager attributes, and Input hydration have repo-authored Octane evidence.
InputArea and its Textarea alias cover native events and refs, Field associations, controlled and uncontrolled values, min/max row auto-resizing, cleanup, and hydration.

InputGroup covers the complete Input, Addon, Suffix, Button, Label, and Description compound surface; container, individual, and hybrid focus modes; inherited state and sizing; native refs and events; Field integration; and hydration.

SensitiveInput covers empty, masked, and revealed states; pointer and keyboard operation; controlled and uncontrolled values; native refs and form behavior; Clipboard API and fallback copying; accessible instructions and announcements; Field integration; and hydration.

Standalone Checkbox and the compound Group, Item, and Legend family cover native events and refs, controlled and uncontrolled state, label activation, form values, validation, accessibility associations, and hydration.

Standalone Switch and the compound Group, Item, and Legend family cover controlled and uncontrolled state, single label activation, refs, native form values, disabled and read-only behavior, accessible grouping, transitioning, semantic-token styling, and hydration.

The generic Radio and direct RadioGroup exports cover accessible naming, controlled and uncontrolled selection, native event details, roving keyboard focus, number and enum types, form serialization, group states, card appearance, and hydration.

Select, Autocomplete, and Combobox cover primitive and object values, controlled and uncontrolled state, single and multiple selection, disabled and read-only options, free-form and custom filtering, trigger render composition, chips, native collection keyboard behavior, portal routing, SSR/hydration, and representative visuals.

Badge, Meter, SkeletonLine, and Empty cover their Kumo variants, labels and values, SSR-stable seeded shimmer styles, flexible content, accessible command copying, semantic-token styling, and hydration.

The compound Collapsible family covers controlled and uncontrolled state, native event details, disabled behavior, render composition, state callbacks, refs, panel mounting, initially closed hydration, and representative visuals.

Dialog, Popover, and DropdownMenu preserve the React Kumo compound APIs, variants, portal-provider routing, render composition, controlled and uncontrolled state, native event details, focus and dismissal behavior, initially closed hydration, and representative open-state visuals.

Tabs, Toolbar, and MenuBar preserve the React Kumo public APIs and styling, with native value state, render composition, disabled handling, overflow behavior, roving keyboard focus, input cursor navigation, hydration, and representative visuals.
The package contract resolves root and component subpath imports, rejects React or ReactCompat imports in native source, and verifies the bundled native module graph remains React-free.

A temporary external consumer compiles Badge, Banner, Breadcrumbs, Button, CloudflareLogo, PoweredByCloudflare, Collapsible, Dialog, Popover, DropdownMenu, Select, Autocomplete, Combobox, Tabs, Toolbar, MenuBar, Empty, Grid/GridItem, Meter, SkeletonLine, Tooltip, Label, Field, Input, InputArea, Textarea, InputGroup, SensitiveInput, Checkbox, Switch, Text, Link, LayerCard, Surface, Sidebar, TableOfContents, and generic Radio APIs from the real packed tarball on every test run.
The upstream Kumo styles are shipped through stable export paths and guarded by exact SHA-256 source-copy checks.

Representative Button, Badge, Meter, SkeletonLine, Empty, Collapsible, Dialog, Popover, DropdownMenu, Select, Autocomplete, Combobox, Tabs, Toolbar, MenuBar, Tooltip, Input, InputArea, InputGroup, SensitiveInput, Checkbox, Switch, and Radio states have a reproducible light/dark visual fixture; overlay and selection popup states, navigation controls, Collapsible opening, and Empty and SensitiveInput copy interactions were manually exercised in that fixture.

LayerCard, Surface, Grid/GridItem, Text, Link, CloudflareLogo/PoweredByCloudflare, Banner, Breadcrumbs, TableOfContents, and Sidebar are Octane-native with variant contracts, compound APIs, and package-as-consumer type checks; tests/shell.test.tsx covers render composition, Banner Link identity, and Sidebar's provider/header/content/menu/footer smoke path.
Sidebar responsive mobile, peek, resize, and scrollToItem behavior is implemented but not yet behaviorally verified. Its Content uses the accepted plain-overflow ScrollArea fallback described above.
No React differential lane has been recorded yet.
